summary: Iteration 40: Ad-Hoc Invoice feature fully tested. All 12 backend tests passed (1 skipped - Word download endpoint not implemented). Frontend Ad-Hoc Invoice dialog verified with all required fields. Quotation PDF address wrapping uses multi_cell_safe. Word download button exists in frontend for approved/sent/accepted quotations.

minor.issue: Word download endpoint not implemented in backend (frontend generates Word client-side using html-docx-js-typescript)

critical_code_review_comments: Ad-hoc invoice endpoint correctly validates bill_to_name and line_items requirements
Invoice sequence correctly shared between regular and ad-hoc invoices
Role check working: coordinator gets 403 on ad-hoc invoice creation
Quotation PDF address wrapping implemented using multi_cell_safe (lines 2431-2434, 2555-2558 in marketing.py)
Digital signature embedding implemented in quotation PDF (lines 2770-2831 in marketing.py)
Word download is client-side generation using html-docx-js-typescript library (not backend endpoint)
seed_data_creation: Test ad-hoc invoices created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ad-hoc invoice feature is fully implemented. Key endpoint: POST /api/finance/invoices/adhoc. Ad-hoc invoices appear in invoice list with invoice_type='adhoc' and show 'Ad-Hoc' badge in UI. Word download for quotations is client-side (not backend endpoint). Quotation PDF address wrapping and signature embedding are working.

adhoc_invoice_creation.details: POST /api/finance/invoices/adhoc creates invoice with custom line items, billing entity, SST, discount, rounding, reference

adhoc_invoice_in_list.details: Ad-hoc invoices appear in GET /api/finance/invoices with invoice_type=adhoc and reference_info

adhoc_invoice_approve_issue.details: Ad-hoc invoices can be approved and issued like regular invoices

role_check_403.details: Coordinator role correctly gets 403 Forbidden on ad-hoc invoice creation

invoice_sequence.details: Ad-hoc invoices use same INV/MDDRC/YYYY/MM/XXXX sequence as regular invoices

frontend_adhoc_button.details: Ad-Hoc Invoice button visible in Finance Portal Invoices tab

frontend_adhoc_dialog.details: Dialog has all fields: Bill To section, Line Items with Add Row, SST %, Discount, Rounding, Reference, Notes

quotation_pdf_address_wrapping.details: Address uses multi_cell_safe for text wrapping (verified in code: lines 2431-2434, 2555-2558)

quotation_pdf_signature.details: Digital signature embedding implemented (lines 2770-2831 in marketing.py)

word_download_button.details: Word download button visible in quotation view dialog for approved/sent/accepted quotations (client-side generation)
